document.abstract: The interchange of television programmes among European countries is called Eurovision. It is not a network or planned operation under a single control, but is essentially the use of a number of independent services and networks on a cooperative basis. This paper describes certain problems encountered in this interchange, such as noncompatible line structure and frame rate, relay time coordination and language problems, and the means of solution.
